candidateAudit.title: Why is the famous Sacher-Torte so expensive? Well, there’s more to it than chocolate and tradition. It all comes down to a rather fascinating story of exclusivity. Back in the 1950
candidateAudit.text: Why is the famous Sacher-Torte so expensive? Well, there’s more to it than chocolate and tradition. It all comes down to a rather fascinating story of exclusivity. Back in the 1950s, Hotel Sacher and Vienna’s famous pastry shop Demel went to war… over a cake! Both claimed the right to call their version the Original Sacher-Torte. After years of legal battles, they reached an agreement in 1963: Only Hotel Sacher could use the name “Original Sacher-Torte”. Demel could still make its own version, but under a different name. So yes, part of what you’re paying for is exclusivity, branding and over 190 years of history. And apparently, people are still willing to queue for it! Personally I prefer Apple strudel! #explorevienna #viennafood #sachertorte #visitvienna #exploreaustria
